- <a id="inv-ack.never_lost"></a>**`ack.never_lost`** · safety · durability — A write the broker acknowledged is never lost: it stays at the offset it was acknowledged at, whatever fails. ("zero RPO")
- <a id="inv-failed.stays_failed"></a>**`failed.stays_failed`** · safety · delivery — A write that failed may have been stored (a timeout leaves its outcome unknown), but it never appears after a later write of the same producer that was acknowledged: a failed write does not come back later.
- <a id="inv-failover.rto_bounded"></a>**`failover.rto_bounded`** · liveness · availability — After a broker fails, every partition takes writes again within 30 s. ("RTO in seconds")
- <a id="inv-idempotence.no_duplicates"></a>**`idempotence.no_duplicates`** · safety · delivery — An idempotent producer's write appears once, even when the client retries it after a fault. (Apache Kafka's idempotent producer; "100% Kafka Compatible")
- <a id="inv-log.no_phantoms"></a>**`log.no_phantoms`** · safety · delivery — Every record in the log was sent by a producer.
- <a id="inv-order.per_partition"></a>**`order.per_partition`** · safety · order — Within a partition, one idempotent producer's writes appear in the order it sent them.
